---
name: Report a broken link
about: Flag an entry whose link is dead or has changed
title: "Broken: "
labels: broken-link
---

**Which entry?**
Copy the line from the README, or paste the project name.

**What changed?**
- [ ] URL returns 404 / DNS fails
- [ ] Project moved to a new home (paste new URL)
- [ ] Project archived / no longer maintained
- [ ] Something else (explain)

**Optional notes**
Anything that helps me decide whether to update the link or remove the entry.
